hazards.control: Pressure test before opening to the well; bleed down and verify zero before breaking any connection.
Wall thickness checks on chokes, tees, and elbows carrying proppant returns.
Stay clear of the coil path, the gooseneck, and flowback iron under flow.

name: Flowback iron
function: The high-pressure hammer-union or flanged piping from wing B of the tree to the solids equipment and choke manifold, rated for the shut-in wellhead pressure.

tabs.overview: Same family as the treating iron but sized for flow rather than pumping; runs are restrained and kept short; elbows and tees are the erosion points.
tabs.engineering: 3 in. 10K class common; restraints; wall thickness inspection.
tabs.connections: Wing B to the plug catcher, sand separator, and choke manifold.
tabs.safety: Live at wellhead pressure; erosion; restraints.
tabs.evidence: Public flowback and well testing overview (S25), field practice (S9).
tabs.operations: Laid at rig-up; inspected each shift.
tabs.failure_modes: Erosion washouts at turns, union leaks.
